data: The orange "pumpkin" suit worn for every Space Shuttle launch and re-entry after Challenger

Full-pressure launch-entry suit developed by David Clark after the Challenger loss made shirtsleeve ascent unacceptable. Replaced the earlier Launch Entry Suit (LES). Detachable gloves, parachute harness integrated, distinctive international-orange colour for water-recovery visibility.
David Clark Co · ACES product page
The orange Shuttle pressure suit worn after Challenger made shirtsleeve ascent unacceptable

Full-pressure launch-entry suit developed by David Clark Company. Replaced the earlier Launch Entry Suit (LES) starting in 1994. Detachable gloves, parachute harness integrated, distinctive international-orange colour for water-recovery visibility. Worn on every Space Shuttle ascent and re-entry through STS-135 in 2011.
